title: Simple transitivity passes to sheafification
statement: Let C be a category with topology J and set-valued sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let G be an abelian group sheaf whose underlying presheaf of sets is a sheaf, and P a presheaf of sets whose sheafification unit eta is locally injective and locally surjective. Let a be a natural operation of G on P, simply transitive on every nonempty section set: for every p the function g maps to a(g,p) is bijective. If b is a natural operation on P-sharp with b(g,eta(p))=eta(a(g,p)), then for every section x of P-sharp the function g maps to b(g,x) is bijective. No nonemptiness hypothesis on P is imposed.

source.place: Tag 00WH, associated sheaf; local bijectivity and sheaf gluing; torsor application as in Tag 03AH of sites-cohomology.tex

proof.text: Equality eta(a(g,p))=eta(a(h,p)) gives a covering equalizer sieve. Naturality and freeness of a identify the restrictions of g and h there. Separatedness of the underlying sheaf of G gives g=h.

For a section x of P-sharp, represent x on its image sieve. The unit formula and naturality reduce equality of translations of x to the preceding result on that cover; separatedness gives injectivity globally.

For sections x,y intersect their image sieves. Choose the unique translations between representatives in P. Their unit images translate x to y locally; the proved injectivity of b makes them compatible under restriction. Glue these group sections in G. Naturality and separatedness of P-sharp prove that the glued section translates x to y, giving surjectivity.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by local representatives, covering sieves and sheaf gluing.

    (a : ∀ U, G.obj.obj U → P.obj U → P.obj U)
    (han : ∀ ⦃U V⦄ (f : U ⟶ V) g t,
      P.map f (a U g t) = a V (G.obj.map f g) (P.map f t))
    (hb : ∀ U t, Function.Bijective (a U · t))
    (b : ∀ U, G.obj.obj U → (sheafify J P).obj U → (sheafify J P).obj U)
    (hn : ∀ ⦃U V⦄ (f : U ⟶ V) g t,
      (sheafify J P).map f (b U g t) =
        b V (G.obj.map f g) ((sheafify J P).map f t))
    (hq : ∀ U g t, b U g ((toSheafify J P).app U t) =
      (toSheafify J P).app U (a U g t)) :
    ∀ U t, Function.Bijective (b U · t)
